info.title: BifrostQL CLI Tool
info.description: CLI tool for managing BifrostQL instances - schema introspection, config generation, and server management.

commands.name: config-generate
commands.description: Generate config rules from database schema patterns

commands.name: config-validate
commands.description: Validate config rules against the database schema

commands.name: Suggestions
commands.description:
• Use --connection-string to provide a connection string
• Or create a bifrostql.json config file with 'bifrost init'

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export database schema to JSON, SQL, or Markdown

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a default bifrostql.json config file

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Print the GraphQL schema (SDL) for the database

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Start a standalone BifrostQL GraphQL server

commands.name: test
commands.description: Test database connection and report schema summary

commands.name: watch
commands.description: Watch for database schema changes and reload

options.name: --json
options.description: Output in JSON format for scripting

options.name: --trust-server-certificate
options.description:
Accept the SQL Server TLS certificate without validating it.
Encrypted but the server's identity is unverified, so anyone
on the network path can intercept it. Use only for a server
whose self-signed certificate you already trust.
